prompt_text: Who is the best roofing company in Dallas for a roof replacement?
answer_verbatim:
“Best” depends on your needs (budget, roof type, timeline, warranty) and on the contractor’s local reputation and credentials. I can help you find the best fit — but first, a few quick questions:
- Is this a residential or commercial roof?
- What Dallas ZIP code or neighborhood are you in?
- What roofing material are you considering (asphalt shingle, metal, tile, flat membrane)?

While you decide, here’s a practical way to identify the best roofing company in Dallas and what to ask when you get quotes:

What to look for
- Local experience: Contractor who regularly works in Dallas/Fort Worth knows local codes, weather issues and permit needs.
- Insurance & licensing: Verify general liability and workers’ comp insurance. Ask about any city registration or trade licenses required locally.
- Manufacturer certification: Prefer companies certified by major shingle/roof manufacturers (GAF, Owens Corning, CertainTeed) — that gives access to better warranties.
- Written, itemized estimate: Labor, materials, cleanup, disposal, permits, and timeline.
- Clear warranty: Ask about both workmanship warranty and manufacturer warranty, and how warranty claims are handled.
- References & reviews: Check Google/Yelp/Angi/HomeAdvisor, and ask the contractor for recent local references you can call.
- BBB and complaint history: Check the Better Business Bureau and Texas consumer complaint databases.
- Permits and inspections: Contractor should pull required permits and arrange inspections (don’t rely on an unpermitted job).
- Payment terms: Avoid large up-front payments; hold final payment until work is complete and you have lien waivers.

Key questions to ask each contractor
- Are you licensed/certified by [manufacturer name]? Can you show proof of insurance?
- Who will do the work — your crew or subcontractors?
- Will you obtain permits and handle inspections?
- What exactly is included (underlayment, decking replacement, flashing, ventilation)?
- What is the projected timeline from start to finish?
- How do you handle change orders and unforeseen repairs?
- Can I have a written contract and a certificate of insurance?
- Can you provide 3 recent local references?

How to choose between estimates
- Don’t pick solely on lowest price. Compare scope of work, materials, ventilation and decking replacement, and warranty terms.
- Prefer a contractor that provides a detailed scope and manufacturer certification even if cost is slightly higher.
- Check responsiveness and professionalism — that often predicts how problems will be handled.

If you want, give me:
- ZIP code/neighborhood
- Residential vs commercial
- Any material preference

I’ll pull together a short list of well-reviewed Dallas roofers and a comparison checklist (based on commonly reported ratings and certifications) so you can contact the top candidates.
